_purpose: Runner preflight, step [0/6] of scripts/daily_run.sh (TASK-RUNNER-PREFLIGHT). Three read-only checks before anything is spent: network, OpenRouter credits, DeepSeek (channel C) balance. Collector windows run the network check only. Read by scripts/preflight.py; IW_PREFLIGHT_CONFIG points at an alternative file.
_floors_note: OpenRouter remaining = total_credits - total_usage from GET /credits. Below the HARD floor the run aborts before spending (default $3, about two full runs at ~$1.1-1.5 each); below the SOFT floor it warns (log + Telegram) and continues.
